$comment: Style Waimia rétro-ingénieré sur les 28 illustrations (reverse prompting du dessin ET du rendu filtré final). Le modèle génère DIRECTEMENT dans la palette finale : pas de filtre après coup. palette-check.mjs vérifie la conformité ; si elle échoue on régénère (duotone.mjs n'est qu'un secours manuel).
drawing_prompt: Mid-century editorial magazine illustration, 1960s screen-print / risograph poster look. Flat graphic shapes, crisp silhouettes, very fine paper grain and subtle halftone texture, slightly imperfect ink registration. One strong conceptual visual metaphor, a little surreal, told without words. Small human figures in sober 1960s business attire (dark suits, pencil skirts, short hair), often seen at a distance or from behind, conveying scale against a large simple shape. Ultra-wide panoramic composition: the whole subject sits inside the central horizontal band, the top and bottom 15% are plain background that will be cropped. Generous negative space, a single focal point, strong light/dark value contrast between subject and background.

duotone-paper.use: sections paper / paper-2 / paper-3 (fond clair). Rendu majoritaire du site.
duotone-paper.prompt: STRICT TWO-TONE MONOCHROME PRINT. The entire image uses only terracotta red #C85130 and warm cream paper #F7F0E7, plus flat in-between tints of that same terracotta mixed with cream (#D98970, #E5B4A2, #EDD3C5). The darkest value anywhere is terracotta #C85130: no black, no grey, no brown, no blue, no green. Overall the image looks like a warm terracotta-on-cream risograph.

duotone-ink.use: sections ink (fond sombre) et blocs inversés.
duotone-ink.prompt: STRICT DARK DUOTONE PRINT. Only three anchor colors: deep brown-black ink #100B08 for the darkest areas, terracotta #BA5032 for the mid-tones, warm cream #F8EFE5 for the lightest areas, plus smooth flat steps between them (#542517, #943C23, #D1785E, #E5B5A3). No pure grey, no blue, no green, no purple. Overall the image looks like a terracotta-and-ink risograph on dark paper.

tritone-paper.use: variante fond clair avec un point froid (ciel, écran, reflet, objet focal secondaire).
tritone-paper.prompt: STRICT THREE-COLOR RISOGRAPH PRINT. Terracotta red #C85130 and warm cream paper #F7F0E7 with their in-between tints (#D98970, #E5B4A2, #EDD3C5), plus exactly ONE accent ink: sky cyan blue #75B0D7, used as flat areas on 10 to 25% of the image (for example the sky, a screen, a window, a reflection or one key object). The blue stays flat and exactly #75B0D7, never shifted to navy, teal or turquoise. The darkest value anywhere is terracotta #C85130: no black, no grey, no other colors.

tritone-ink.use: variante fond sombre avec le point froid cyan.
tritone-ink.prompt: STRICT THREE-COLOR DARK RISOGRAPH PRINT. Deep brown-black ink #100B08, terracotta #BA5032 and warm cream #F8EFE5 with flat steps between them (#542517, #943C23, #D1785E, #E5B5A3), plus exactly ONE accent ink: sky cyan blue #75B0D7 used as flat areas on 10 to 25% of the image (sky, screen, window, reflection or one key object). The blue stays flat and exactly #75B0D7, never shifted to navy, teal or turquoise. No grey, no green, no purple, no other colors.

ink_from_paper_prompt: Recolor this exact illustration without changing the drawing, the composition, the figures or the grain. Keep every shape in place. Apply this palette:
negative_prompt: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, signs with writing, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, no 3D render, no glossy gradients, no neon, no purple, no busy patterns, no stock-photo look, no robots, glowing brains or circuit-board clichés, no tomatoes or food unless asked

check.comment: Delta E CIE76 Lab de chaque pixel à la couleur la plus proche de (colors + tints). coverage = part des pixels à moins de 12 de Delta E. cyan_*_share : uniquement pour les palettes tritone. cyan_max_share 0.75 : les compositions « grand ciel » (référence computer-health) ont jusqu'à ~70 % de bleu.

style_anchors: House style reference 1: a calm woman in a 1960s dress sits in a lounge chair with a laptop while her own giant shadow stands behind her and types on another laptop; plain background, pale floor band.
House style reference 2: a tiny lone figure on a dark textured ground at the far left, a gigantic arcing wave of stacked bands sweeping up across the sky; 70% empty space.
House style reference 3: a giant laptop floats in a vast plain sky, a heartbeat line crosses the whole image, a grainy cloud, a thin strip of countryside with two tiny houses at the very bottom.
